local_context.value: NWS Tampa Bay: the rainy season runs May 25 to October 10 for West Central Florida outside Southwest Florida, peaks July through early September; heavy rainfall, frequent lightning, and from late May through June hail and damaging winds are common. Wikipedia (Kathleen, Florida) lists Kathleen as a census-designated place (not an incorporated city) in Polk County at 118 ft (36 m) elevation; a post office named Kathleen has operated since 1886. No official source found for housing-stock age or local drainage.

neighborhoods.value: Meadow View Oaks (manufactured and single-family homes, built 2005-2022 per a real-estate listing site), Pine Meadow Acres (rural acreage community, Pine Meadow Road), Fox Branch (planned community on west side of Kathleen Road, 952 units approved per commercial listing). Real-estate sources only; no official list found; fewer than 4 verified.

place_entities.value: Partial: Kathleen Senior High School (1100 Red Devil Way; Wikipedia places it in Lakeland, 33805; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kathleen_Senior_High_School, Wikidata Q6376747); Kathleen Middle School (3627 Kathleen Pines Avenue, Lakeland; no Wikipedia article); Kathleen Elementary School (Lakeland; no Wikipedia article). Kathleen CDP itself Wikidata Q602145. No named park found. Fewer than 3 solid entities; all schools are addressed Lakeland.

permit_office.value: Kathleen is an unincorporated CDP, so residential building permits come from the Polk County Building Division (County Administration Building, 330 W. Church St., Bartow; (863) 534-6080; applications online through the county's Accela portal). Basis: Polk County Building Division page title/search excerpts plus the CDP's non-municipal status; the official page text itself could not be fetched.
